row:
A Safefurr Place is a non-profit animal rescue organization in Bakersfield California that also serves the surrounding areas of Kern County.

Our animal rescue channel features the stories of the abandoned, homeless, and neglected dogs and cats we have saved from the streets and rural areas of Kern County. There is nothing more rewarding than seeing these discarded pets transform back into the healthy and happy dogs and cats they once were, and helping them find the loving, forever homes they deserve.

PayPal donations  - http://www.paypal.com (Our account is @asafefurrplace)
Venmo donations - http://www.venmo.com (Our account is @ASP-Rescue)
Cash App donations - https://cash.app/$asafefurrplace
